card.text: Explore Steins with a Rosetta photomosaic, its irregular shape and mapped elevation.

introduction.text: Rosetta flew past diamond-shaped Šteins in 2008. A chain of depressions crosses its surface.

osiris.title: OSIRIS photographs
osiris.summary: Two Rosetta photographs show Šteins during the 2008 approach. The asteroid is only a few dozen pixels wide in each original image, so small surface details aren’t resolved. The grid marks gaps.

normal.title: OSIRIS image mosaic
normal.summary: Photographed shadows, seams and processing edits remain in the published mosaic. The gray grid marks missing map coverage.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 2.58 km sphere. The far side is modeled; a source seam joins it to image-based terrain.
